arc._comment_inactivity_timeout: Seconds the SSH channel may stay silent before CVS abandons the run (minimum 120). CVS prints an ARC heartbeat every 60 s, so this fires only if the controller shell or SSH stalls.
arc._comment_run_timeout: Wall-clock limit in seconds for one ARC run. When exceeded, CVS stops ARC's process group on the controller and fails the test. ARC limits each item itself (ANCGPUTest: 5400 s); raise this for long flows. 0 disables.
arc._comment_install_timeout: Seconds without installer output before install times out.
arc._comment_arc_version: Minimum ARC version required on every controller.
arc._comment_ARC_INSTALL_PATH: Tar-only install prefix. Blank uses /opt/amdtools; deb/rpm use /opt/amdtools.
arc._comment_controller_nodes: Deprecated; used only when the cluster file has no racks block. Set racks.<rack_id>.arc_controller in the cluster file instead.
arc._comment_rack_config: Optional. Path to a rack JSON you staged on each controller. Leave empty to have CVS generate each rack's file from the cluster file's racks block.
arc._comment_spec_mode: Rack validation mode: full or partial.
arc._comment_mock: Set True to run with MOCK=1. Release builds reject --mock.
arc._comment_continue_on_failure: Continue ARC content execution after an item failure.
arc._comment_allow_disruptive: Set True to allow hardware-state-changing flows and items.
arc._comment_print_all_to_console: Stream ARC output. False hides it. Both modes print a heartbeat every 60 s and the run sentinels.
arc._comment_ADD_ARC_LOGS_TO_HTML_REPORTS: Attach log tarballs on passing runs too; failures always attach.
